item.text: {"decisions": [{"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0001", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0001 is the CIDOB institutional header and biographical identification block. It contains only institutional provenance metadata, birth date, party affiliation, and political succession information. No substantive content about economic governance, fiscal policy, budgets, competition rules, anti-corruption enforcement, tax policy, labor policy, shock response, or economic trajectory exists in this unit.", "exclusion_reason": "Institutional header and biographical identification only. No economic governance content."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0002", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0002 covers general political characterization of López Obrador's charismatic leadership, combative discourse, and third presidential candidacy framing. No specific economic policy content beyond general political positioning. The substantive 2018 economic platform appears separately in unit-0005.", "exclusion_reason": "General political characterization without substantive economic policy content."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0003", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0003 covers the 2006 electoral conflict, Felipe Calderón's victory, López Obrador's denial and civil disobedience. Entirely focused on electoral legitimacy dispute. No economic governance content.", "exclusion_reason": "Electoral legitimacy conflict coverage with no economic governance content."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0004", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0004 covers the 2012 electoral defeat to Peña Nieto, López Obrador's departure from PRD, and MORENA creation. While it references EPN's energy, educational, telecom, and labor reforms as rejected by López Obrador, the unit is framed entirely around party-political rupture and electoral opposition. The economic reform references are incidental to the political narrative and do not constitute evidence of López Obrador's own economic governance approach.", "exclusion_reason": "Party-political rupture and electoral defeat narrative. Economic reform references are incidental opposition framing, not evidence of López Obrador's economic governance approach."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0005", "included": true, "relevant_question_ids": ["5B.1", "5B.3", "5B.6", "5B.8", "5B.9"], "relevance_strength": "material", "adjacent_chunk_ids": ["unit-0006"], "explanation": "Unit-0005 presents the 2018 campaign program core economic commitments in detail: 'austeridad republicana' reorienting public resources from current spending to investment without tax increases or debt issuance; social programs addressing poverty and human development for vulnerable populations; fuel price reduction through domestic production; energy and food self-sufficiency with price guarantees for producers; corruption eradication by example; and firm defense of migrants. These directly address 5B.1 (prosperity agenda vs rents/loyalty purchases), 5B.3 (credible fiscal rules, no new debt/tax increases), 5B.6 (budget outputs for social infrastructure), 5B.8 (distribution of gains to poor/vulnerable), and 5B.9 (shock response framework for inflation/fuel prices).", "exclusion_reason": null}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0006", "included": true, "relevant_question_ids": ["5B.1", "5B.3", "5B.4"], "relevance_strength": "weak", "adjacent_chunk_ids": ["unit-0005", "unit-0007"], "explanation": "Unit-0006 describes the 2018-2024 platform's ideological framing as pragmatic social democracy assuming free market principles, macroeconomic stability, budget discipline, and peso flotation, combined with rejection of neoliberal privatization and prioritization of national production. This is relevant to 5B.1 (prosperity agenda framing), 5B.3 (macroeconomic stability commitment), and 5B.4 (entrepreneurship/property framework). The content is ideological description rather than specific policy detail, hence weak rather than material.", "exclusion_reason": null}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0007", "included": true, "relevant_question_ids": ["5B.4"], "relevance_strength": "weak", "adjacent_chunk_ids": ["unit-0006"], "explanation": "Unit-0007 covers the USMCA trade agreement replacing NAFTA, López Obrador's assessment of it as beneficial, and migration caravan tensions at the northern border with Trump's threatened border closure. Relevant to 5B.4 (trade/investment framework) as it documents the trade policy environment. However, the unit is primarily about migration and geopolitical tension rather than López Obrador's own economic governance decisions.", "exclusion_reason": null}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0008", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0008 covers López Obrador's birth in 1953, family background (father a peasant/watchman at a Pemex depot, mother a Spanish immigrant), childhood in Tabasco, brother's accidental death in 1969, family's move to Palenque Chiapas, and return to store-keeping and hospitality business. Pure biographical/family history.", "exclusion_reason": "Early life and family biography with no economic governance content."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0009", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0009 covers López Obrador's 1972 move to Mexico City, UNAM enrollment in political science, and early political work within the PRI through a 1976 campaign for senator Carlos Pellicer. Career timeline without economic governance content.", "exclusion_reason": "Early career within PRI party machinery without substantive economic governance content."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0010", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0010 covers López Obrador's delegation work at INI in La Chontalpa, direction of Sectoral Studies at the state secretariat, teaching sociology and pedagogy at the Universidad Autónoma de Tabasco, marriage to Rocío Beltrán Medina in 1980, and three children born 1982-1991. No economic governance content.", "exclusion_reason": "Early governmental delegation work and personal biography without economic governance content."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0011", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0011 covers López Obrador's work on Enrique González Pedrero's 1982 gubernatorial campaign, his role as director of CEPES, his appointment as PRD chairman in Tabasco in 1983, internal party conflicts, his dismissal in November 1983, return to the DF in 1984 to work at INCO, 1986 book publication, 1987 graduation from UNAM, and joining the Democratic Current within PRI. No economic governance content.", "exclusion_reason": "Party internal work, academic publication, and early political biography without economic governance content."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0012", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0012 covers the 1987 Democratic Current formation with Cuauhtémoc Cárdenas and Porfirio Muñoz Ledo, the 1988 federal elections where Salinas defeated Cárdenas, López Obrador's own gubernatorial candidacy in Tabasco, accusations of electoral fraud, and his subsequent book 'Tabasco víctima del fraude'. Entirely focused on electoral fraud disputes.", "exclusion_reason": "Electoral fraud disputes and party formation history without economic governance content."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0013", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0013 covers PRD founding on May 5 1989, the 1991 democracy march from Tabasco to Mexico City, and post-march electoral negotiations. No economic governance content.", "exclusion_reason": "Party founding and electoral protest march without substantive economic governance content."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0014", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0014 covers López Villarreal's second failed gubernatorial campaign in 1994, accusations of fraud by Madrazo, mobilization efforts including the 1995 caravan for democracy, establishment of a National Democratic Alliance, and publication of his fourth book documenting corruption and democratic struggle. The FOBAPROA reference in this unit concerns the Salinas-era bank rescue fund and is cited as an example of fraud activism, not as evidence of López Obrador's own economic governance during a period when he held no executive office.", "exclusion_reason": "Failed gubernatorial campaign, electoral fraud activism, and opposition period with no executive governance record. FOBAPROA cited in opposition mode, not as governing evidence."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0015", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0015 covers López Obrador's July 1996 election as PRD president with 73.9% of party votes, following his leadership of indigenous protests against PEMEX management in Tabasco. Purely party internal politics with no economic governance content.", "exclusion_reason": "Party presidency election and internal PRD politics without economic governance content."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0016", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0016 covers Cuauhtémoc Cárdenas' 1997 election as DF chief of government, PRD electoral successes in 1997-1999, and López Obrador's handover of party presidency to Pablo Gómez Álvarez in April 1999. No economic governance content.", "exclusion_reason": "Electoral results and party leadership handover without economic governance content."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0017", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0017 covers López Obrador's November 1999 DF primary victory with 75.5%, his publication of FOBAPROA investigation findings, and characterization of the fund as 'el fraude más grande de la historia después de la Conquista'. This is opposition critique of a prior administration's banking policy. López Obrador was not in executive office and was acting as opposition activist publishing investigative findings.", "exclusion_reason": "FOBAPROA publication as opposition activist, not as governing executive. No executive economic governance evidence."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0018", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0018 covers López Obrador's July 2000 DF chief of government election victory with 34.5% of votes, a narrow margin over Santiago Creel. Election result reporting without policy content.", "exclusion_reason": "DF election victory announcement without substantive economic governance content."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0019", "included": true, "relevant_question_ids": ["5B.6", "5B.7", "5B.8"], "relevance_strength": "weak", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0019 describes López Obrador's 2000-2005 DF government period: vigorous public works campaign for urban infrastructure, social protection programs including Pensión Universal Alimenticia para Adultos Mayores, commitment to accountability, transparency, and participatory democracy, and characterizations of his governance style as honest and committed to regular reporting. Relevant to 5B.6 (budget outputs for infrastructure/social programs), 5B.7 (transparency and accountability), and 5B.8 (distribution to vulnerable populations). However, this is subnational DF government, and the source is a political biography providing summary characterizations rather than systematic evidence on actual budget quality or output delivery.", "exclusion_reason": null}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0020", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0020 covers López Obrador's communication style, poor rhetorical skills compared to adversaries, ability to connect with popular classes, and intensive use of media including 6am press conferences ('mañaneras'). Political communication characterization without economic governance content.", "exclusion_reason": "Communication style characterization without economic governance content."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0021", "included": true, "relevant_question_ids": ["5B.6", "5B.8"], "relevance_strength": "weak", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0021 covers DF government results: vigorous public works for urban infrastructure, social programs including Pensión Universal Alimenticia para Adultos Mayores, refusal to implement Seguro Popular on grounds that DF residents already received free municipal social coverage, and PAN opposition criticism of populist spending and debt increase. Relevant to 5B.6 (budget outputs for infrastructure) and 5B.8 (distribution programs for the elderly). However, the content is political characterization by a political biography with no systematic data on actual output quality or delivery outcomes.", "exclusion_reason": null}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0022", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0022 covers the March 2004 video scandal: Televisa broadcast of clandestine videos showing PRD officials including René Bejarano and Carlos Ímaz receiving money from businessman Carlos Ahumada Kurtz in a casino. Corruption by López Obrador's subordinates documented, but the unit is entirely about the scandal revelation and López Obrador's characterization of it as political conspiracy rather than about his own anti-corruption enforcement or economic governance.", "exclusion_reason": "Video scandal revelation about subordinates' corruption. López Obrador's response framed as political conspiracy theory, not as anti-corruption governance action."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0023", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0023 covers the political aftermath of the video scandal: PRD break with implicated officials, prosecution for fraud and money laundering, Rosario Robles' resignation, and López Obrador's late/tardy rejection of the corruption paired with counterattack characterizing the scandal as a conspiracy by Salinas, Fernández de Cevallos, and Fox. No evidence of anti-corruption enforcement or economic governance action.", "exclusion_reason": "Scandal political aftermath. Late/tardy rejection of subordinates' corruption paired with conspiracy framing. No anti-corruption enforcement action documented."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0024", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0024 covers the May 2004 desafuero request by the PGR regarding a land expropriation dispute in Cuajimalpa dating to 2000. Entirely a legal/constitutional conflict without economic governance content.", "exclusion_reason": "Legal desafuero proceeding regarding land expropriation dispute. No economic governance content."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0025", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0025 covers the August 2004 demonstration of 200,000 supporters in the Zócalo and López Obrador's book presenting a 20-point alternative nation program. Civil mobilization content without economic governance evidence.", "exclusion_reason": "Civil mobilization and alternative nation program book announcement without economic governance implementation evidence."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0026", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0026 covers the April 2005 congressional vote approving the desafuero (360-127), López Obrador's civil resistance mobilization, and legal defense arguments. Political conflict with no economic governance content.", "exclusion_reason": "Desafuero congressional vote and civil resistance mobilization. No economic governance content."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0027", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0027 covers the May 2005 withdrawal of charges against López Obrador, his July 2005 resignation as DF head of government to focus on PRD presidential primary, and Cárdenas' withdrawal from the primary race. Legal resolution and primary candidacy process without economic governance content.", "exclusion_reason": "Legal resolution and presidential primary candidacy process without economic governance content."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0028", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0028 covers the 2006 presidential campaign launch, López Obrador's contrast with Calderón and Madrazo, and general campaign positioning. High-level political contrast framing without specific economic policy content.", "exclusion_reason": "General 2006 presidential campaign launch and political contrast framing without substantive economic policy content."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0029", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0029 covers Calderón's electoral positioning, accusations of nepotism regarding BANOBRAS and the Energy secretary, López Obrador's FOBAPROA critique ('privatization of gains and socialization of losses'), and PAN campaign spots linking López to economic danger. These are electoral accusations and counter-accusations, not evidence of López Obrador's economic governance. His critique of FOBAPROA as opposition figure does not constitute governing evidence.", "exclusion_reason": "Electoral accusations and counter-accusations during 2006 campaign. Opposition critique of FOBAPROA not evidence of own economic governance."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0030", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0030 covers the 2006 campaign program: ending the privileges, corruption, and 'saqueo' sponsored by the federal government; halving presidential salary; investigating FOBAPROA via a Truth Commission; and reducing corruption. Campaign promises, not governing evidence. López Obrador was not in executive office.", "exclusion_reason": "2006 campaign program promises. Candidate without executive office making policy commitments, not implementing them."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0031", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0031 covers campaign social development programs, PRD defense of labor rights and just wages, and agricultural sector support proposals. Campaign promises that repeat content already present in unit-0005's more detailed 2018 campaign program description.", "exclusion_reason": "2006 campaign social program promises (repeat of campaign content already covered in unit-0005's more detailed 2018 program description). Entirely focused on electoral legitimacy dispute.", "exclusion_reason": "Post-election legitimacy conflict and civil resistance mobilization. No economic governance content."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0035", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0035 covers the TEPJF recount results, annulment of 237,000 votes, and maintenance of Calderón's victory margin at 0.56%. Political theater of parallel government without economic governance content.", "exclusion_reason": "Parallel government self-inauguration and civil resistance organization.
